chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
"Salat (prayer), sawm (fasting), hajj, charity, and emancipation enter upon the deceased in his grave."

key_terms.الصَّدَقَةُ: charity given for benefit and reward
key_terms.الصَّلَاةُ: salat (prayer), an act of worship whose benefit reaches the deceased
key_terms.الصَّوْمُ: sawm (fasting), an act of worship whose benefit reaches the deceased
key_terms.الْحَجُّ: hajj, the pilgrimage whose benefit reaches the deceased
key_terms.الْعِتْقُ: emancipation of a slave as a meritorious deed
key_terms.قَبْرِهِ: his grave, referring to his state after burial

ai.seo_question: Which deeds benefit a deceased person in the grave according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states that acts such as salat (prayer), sawm (fasting), hajj, charity, and emancipation benefit the deceased in the grave. It indicates the continuing effect of righteous deeds and their connection to the state of the dead in barzakh.
